mentions.name: repulp
mentions.description: This project re-typesets historical science fiction pulp magazines (starting with Analog/Astounding) into a modern ebook format, preserving the rich mixed content of the originals — covers re-typeset with original art, most of the interior, and many of the ads — with plans to package the output into epub files.
mentions.problem: Historical magazines and periodicals don't translate well to modern ebook formats; PDF doesn't cut it and most other conversion efforts are unsatisfactory because they lose the rich, mixed content that makes a magazine a magazine.
mentions.source_excerpt: So, for the past few weeks (months?) I've been taking a stab at it with the science fiction pulps. Started with Analog/Astounding, and I was able to re-typeset the cover (with original art), most of the interior, many of the ads, and so on.
